scope: ADR-0009 Appendix A historical observations plus the two approved clean GATE2 multiplier probes after the q1 controller-mimic opt-out
result: The historical observations remain invalid for sign inference. The clean +1 GATE2 restored q2-master open/close tracking and link motion; the clean -1 GATE2 locked both fingers at zero. Therefore +1 is the only supported Bullet SDF multiplier, but GATE2 remains blocked by a 1.674 mm no-command hold error.

counterfactuals.encoding: q1 SDF mimic multiplier -1; no URDF, controller, geometry, or sensor change
counterfactuals.result: CONTAMINATED_OBSERVATION: both directions remained at zero; passive initial-state acceptance missed by 20 mm while the q1 controller-side mimic loop was also active.

counterfactuals.encoding: q2 SDF axis +Y, q2 joint-frame pi roll, inverse q2 child-link roll, q1 SDF mimic multiplier +1
counterfactuals.result: CONTAMINATED_OBSERVATION: one-way force-balance signature reproduced while the q1 controller-side mimic loop was also active.

post_timebox_static_audit.scope: the q1 ros2_control structural-mimic opt-out is applied; clean multiplier probes preserve geometry, sensors, limits, interfaces, and SDF semantics except for the authorized -1 counterfactual
post_timebox_static_audit.finding: hardware_interface 4.45.2 derives controller mimic from the structural URDF unless q1 has ros2_control mimic="false". With that opt-out, the clean +1 probe has no q1 controller-mimic log and q2 reaches 0.04 m / 0.01 m with at most 0.272 mm / 0.0011 mm error. The only remaining GATE2 failure is a no-command initial position of 0.0183258 m, 1.6742 mm below the required 0.02 m ±1 mm.
post_timebox_static_audit.candidate_repair: No physical or controller change is selected. Preserve q1 mimic="false" and +1 SDF multiplier; diagnose the independent q2 no-command hold error without relaxing the 1 mm threshold or reintroducing a q1 command path.

contaminated_post_removal_run.runtime_log: The pre-opt-out run still logged q1 as mimicking q2; it is retained only as evidence that direct params alone were insufficient.
contaminated_post_removal_run.result: CONTAMINATED_OBSERVATION: passive state sagged by 6.712 mm; q2 open to 0.04 m stalled at 0.01599 m; close to 0.01 m passed. It is not multiplier-sign evidence.

next_command: Diagnose the 1.674 mm no-command q2 hold error without restoring q1 controller mimic or relaxing the 1 mm threshold; then rerun clean +1 GATE2 before GATE3–5.
